findings.problem: A minibatch in which no pair of batches can be compared now adds a zero alignment loss and a zero gradient, so the fit finishes. Nothing in the saved latent, its `config` or its loss history records how many steps were skipped (the history keeps per-epoch means of `adv_div`, which average the zeros in). Before the fix such a fit crashed, which was loud. SI-52 (user decision 52: the new guards must fail loudly and never silently change a result) is therefore only partly met: fits that never hit the case are unchanged, but a fit that does hit it used to stop and now finishes without a trace. The final review asked to 'decide and document' what an inactive minibatch contributes; the decision (zero) is written in the alignment.py module docstring and code comments, not in the methods or preregistration text. In the verifier's own crash-rate table the exposed rows are X7 reference-aligned MMD on pancreas (27 fits) and sim1 (18 fits), where nearly every fit hits it (about 0.17% and 0.30% of minibatch steps), and, rarely, X3 atac_small MMD, X8 sim2 MMD and X1 sim1 (table below). The effect on a result is probably tiny, but a referee cannot see it.

findings.problem: Outside the six fixes but an operator will meet it: the builder refuses any commit other than c88cce3 (`TAG_SHA`), and the plan says the code is 'the tag prereg-tier12-v2 (c88cce3), unchanged', because the 75 X1 baseline fits already made on JHPCE are at c88cce3 and fits from a new commit would trip the runner's mixed-commit check. The six fixes (I033 in particular, which the review required before the X1 sim1 rows run) need a new tag, so after it exists that statement, the builder constant and tests/jhpce/test_x1_command.py (which bundles TAG_SHA) are out of date, and the 75 baseline fits at c88cce3 and the new X1 fits would not share one commit.
findings.evidence: `grep -n "TAG_SHA\|expected-sha" experiments/X1_jhpce/x1_jhpce_command.py`: line `TAG_SHA = "c88cce3c..."`, and the refusal `--expected-sha must be prereg-tier12-v2`. SUBMISSION_PLAN 'Code and inputs': 'Code: the tag prereg-tier12-v2 (c88cce3), unchanged'.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-pin TAG_SHA, the plan text and the test when the new tag is cut; decide beforehand how the 75 existing X1 baseline fits are treated (refit at the new tag or amend the one-commit rule).

findings.problem: The repository's own before/after bit-identity gate cannot run against the tag or any later base: it exports only `scripts/scvi_adversarial_plan.py` and `src/wcd_vae/wcd/` of the base commit, but since commit b0564fb the plan imports `scripts/fit_outcome.py`, so the base fits stop with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fit_outcome'`. The script's exit code for this crash (1) is the same as for 'a difference was found'. SI-52 asks for bit-identity on non-Sinkhorn arms; with this gate it cannot be shown. I used my own driver (`probes/bitid_driver.py`, same idea, exporting the whole `scripts/` and `src/`) for section 4.1. No defect of the six fixes.
findings.evidence:
Command: `python scripts/check_arm_bitidentity.py --base c88cce3 --out X` from the head (the same with base 1c49b9a). Output (logs/bitid_arms_vs_tag_c88cce3.log, first lines; the script then exits with code 1, the code it also uses for 'a difference was found'):

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 9, in <module>
  File "<tmp>/base/scripts/scvi_adversarial_plan.py", line 54, in <module>
    from fit_outcome import NonFiniteLossError   # scripts/fit_outcome.py; scripts/ is on sys.path for every importer
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fit_outcome'
```

`export_base` writes `scripts/scvi_adversarial_plan.py` and `src/wcd_vae/wcd/*` of the base commit into a temporary tree; the plan has imported `scripts/fit_outcome.py` since commit b0564fb (an ancestor of the tag). Used instead: `probes/bitid_driver.py` and `probes/bitid_compare.py` (same idea; whole `scripts/` and `src/` exported), results in section 4.1.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `scripts/fit_outcome.py` (or the whole `scripts/` directory) to the files `export_base` writes, and give the crash a different exit code from a bit difference.
